@@U03937@@
and more the mind. So down to 哈得斯, now, ladies! Our Queen has gone before with solemn tread; it’s for us, her loyal ones, to fill her footsteps! We'll find her at the throne of the Inscrutable One.

@@U03939@@
Queens, of course, are happy anywhere. Even in 哈得斯 they're right at the top, rubbing shoulders with the best, even 珀耳塞福涅. As for us, we serve as the background, buried in deep fields of asphodel, companions to gangly poplars and fruitless willows. And what are we to do? Squeak and twitter like bats, unpleasant, ghostly whispering sighs?

@@U03941@@
They who have made no name nor sought great ends, belong to the elements. So away with you all! I have a grand longing to be with my Queen; loyalty and merit preserve us as we are.

@@U03942@@
(Exit. )

@@U03944@@
Restored to the day’s light, we are beings no longer, we feel it, we know it— never to return to 哈得斯, never. Eternal Nature, Nature undying, claiming us, makes us one with her, her spirits, as we lay claim on her.

@@U03946@@
Here amid these thousand branches, swaying, trembling, rustling, whispering,
translation:
@@U03937@@
以及更多的心灵。现在，女士们，哈得斯！我们的女王迈着庄严的步伐走在前面；这是为了我们，她忠实的人，去追随她的脚步！我们会在神秘者的王座上找到她。

@@U03939@@
当然，女王在任何地方都很开心。即使在哈得斯，他们也名列前茅，与最优秀的人甚至珀耳塞福涅并肩。至于我们，则是背景，埋在水仙花的深处，与细长的杨树和不结果子的柳树为伴。我们该怎么办？像蝙蝠一样吱吱叫、叽叽喳喳，令人不快、幽灵般的低语叹息？

@@U03941@@
那些不曾成名也不追求伟大目标的人属于元素。所以，你们都走开吧！我非常渴望和我的女王在一起；忠诚和优点使我们保持原样。

@@U03942@@
（退出。）

@@U03944@@
恢复白昼的光明，我们不再是存在，我们感觉到了，我们知道了——永远不会回到哈得斯，永远不会。永恒的自然，不朽的自然，索取了我们，使我们与她、她的精神合而为一，就像我们索取她的权利一样。

@@U03946@@
在这千百根树枝中，摇曳、颤抖、沙沙作响、窃窃私语，
